pairs.registryProposal: Revision 4's native-side-owns-the-target-set reaches UI caller contexts whose native side lives elsewhere (src-tauri/src/commands/fleet/); the map pairs this subject only with frontend contexts, so the Rust fleet-commands context that owns the handlers is unpaired - the matcher missed it (repo says dispatch brief / spawn / cwd where the technique says target set / allow-list).
